name: skyhop
description: Endless vertical jumper. Steer Hopbot, a robot on a pogo spring, from ledge to ledge and climb from the garden through the skies, dusk and night into space. Drifting, bobbing, vanishing and crumbling ledges, springs, balloons, rockets, a bubble shield, critters to stomp or zap. Steer by tilting the console (a one-time set-up learns how the motion sensor is mounted; the D-pad works too); best score saved to NVS.
